Definition: Whether the digital ID is recognized or interoperable across borders through regional agreements or travel documents
Comments: No evidence of formal cross-border interoperability or regional recognition of the DRC national ID/DRCPass found. DRC is a COMESA and SADC member state, and COMESA is working on cross-border trade facilitation, but the DRC national ID is not part of any formally interoperable regional identity framework. The DRCPass is a new system in early rollout with no regional recognition agreements announced. The COMESA Simplified Trade Regime at Kasumbalesa (DRC-Zambia) facilitates trade but does not entail ID interoperability. Searched for SADC/COMESA ID recognition for DRC specifically; no formal agreements found.

revision_notes: A light check surfaced an authoritative, well-corroborated regional initiative (SADC Committee of Central Bank Governors, Co-Develop and FinMark Trust, announced August 2025; SAIIA policy paper, November 2025) so the row was moved from fast-path confirmation to full verification. DRC is listed among the 16 SADC member states nominally within scope of a planned federated eKYC/digital-ID interoperability framework, but the only cross-border ID verification piloted to date is between South Africa and Lesotho; no source shows DRC's national ID (RDC-PASS, launched 2026 and still in early rollout) as actually recognised or interoperable across any border. This is stronger evidence than a bare Unknown: the correct code is 1 (No), not 0. Recommend human confirmation given the fast-evolving regional framework, but the current evidence base does not support scoring above 'No'.
revised_comments: DR Congo's digital ID (RDC-PASS) is not currently recognised or interoperable across borders through any regional agreement or travel document. DRC is nominally included within the scope of a newly announced SADC federated eKYC framework (Committee of Central Bank Governors, Co-Develop and FinMark Trust, August 2025) intended to link national digital ID systems for cross-border identity verification, but implementation to date has only been piloted between South Africa and Lesotho. No formal cross-border recognition of the DRC ID has been established.
